name: fmt
note: VARARGS (cdecl, caller cleans; 197 call sites with varying ADD SP). Own sprintf: '#' instead of '%'; flags '_' (pad '{'?), '+'c (pad char c), '0'; width digits or '*'n (fit to n cols via text_fit_width, +1000 marker); specifier table DS:0153 (6 chars) with handler offsets at +12: int (#d via fmt_int), char, long (#l via fmt_long), string (#s, padded/truncated), '#v'-like char-0x40, bar graph (writes glyph codes 1..7, #f); unknown -> "Fuck" (DS:0d1a). Returns far_calloc(1000) string (DX:AX), caller frees
